narrative_shape: C test scaffolding unit. Authoring (Edit 7, Write 5, Read 20), appending an entry to a shared IMPLEMENTATION.md without touching another unit's concurrent additions (T69-71), then a full pytest run under a bounded wait (T72-75, timeout 3300 polling every 10s). T85 confirms sha identical to the perth_j1 reference, T87-89 verifies gitignore, stages only owned paths and commits.
